{{Top|leg}}
A '''manlift''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-driven personnel elevator used in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities. It was a small, box-like cage that functioned like a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] but with only vertical movement. It could transport at least three individuals at a time.
